body:
Upgrade your Minecraft experience with the exterillera! This mod brings a fresh twist to tool crafting by introducing new stick materials—Stone, Iron, Emerald, Diamond, and Netherite.

What’s New:

1. New Sticks: Craft tools with Stone, Iron, Emerald, Diamond, and Netherite sticks for improved durability and efficiency.
   
2.Tool Enhancements: The mod updates all essential tools—including swords, hoes, shovels, pickaxes, and axes—with these new sticks, boosting their performance and lifespan.

Why Download This Mod?

1.Improved Durability: The new sticks contribute to the longevity of your tools, reducing the frequency of repairs or replacements.

2.Enhanced Efficiency: Experience more efficient mining, farming, and combat with tools that have optimized performance based on their stick material.

3.Aesthetic Variety: Add a touch of customization and style to your gear with a range of stick materials, each offering a unique look and feel.

Elevate your crafting game and enjoy a more refined and functional toolset with the Enhanced Sticks Mod!
